Anti-Apple Inc Institutional Investors Sentiment Runs Low in Q1 2018
June 27, 2018 - By Kristen Paramore Sentiment for Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL)
Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) institutional sentiment decreased to 0.69 in Q1 2018 . Its down -0.04, from 0.73 in 2017Q4. The ratio dived, as 770 funds started new and increased holdings, while 1108 sold and trimmed equity positions in Apple Inc. The funds in our partner’s database now hold: 2.86 billion shares, down from 2.98 billion shares in 2017Q4. Also, the number of funds holding Apple Inc in their top 10 holdings decreased from 948 to 922 for a decrease of 26. Sold All: 69 Reduced: 1039 Increased: 645 New Position: 125.
Apple Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players to consumers, small and mid-sized businesses, and education, enterprise, and government clients worldwide. The company has market cap of $917.41 billion. The firm also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. It has a 18.06 P/E ratio. It offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers.
The stock increased 1.20% or $2.22 during the last trading session, reaching $186.65. About 8.60 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on August, 7. They expect $2.19 earnings per share, up 31.14 % or $0.52 from last year’s $1.67 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $10.76 billion for 21.31 P/E if the $2.19 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.73 actual earnings per share reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -19.78 % negative EPS growth.
Harvard Management Co Inc holds 34.77% of its portfolio in Apple Inc. for 1.69 million shares. Lyons Wealth Management Llc. owns 115,119 shares or 29.35% of their US portfolio. Moreover, Independent Investors Inc has 25.86% invested in the company for 386,568 shares. The Nebraska-based Berkshire Hathaway Inc has invested 21.27% in the stock. Trb Advisors Lp, a New York-based fund reported 50,000 shares.
Since January 1, 0001, it had 0 buys, and 13 selling transactions for $52.34 million activity. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Ratings Coverage
Ratings analysis reveals 54% of Apple’s analysts are positive. Out of 35 Wall Street analysts rating Apple, 19 give it “Buy”, 0 “Sell” rating, while 16 recommend “Hold”. The lowest target is $157 while the high is $235. The stock’s average target of $198.46 is 6.33% above today’s ($186.65) share price. AAPL was included in 80 notes of analysts from January 2, 2018. The rating was maintained by Canaccord Genuity with “Buy” on Tuesday, January 23. RBC Capital Markets maintained it with “Buy” rating and $21000 target in Monday, June 25 report. The company was maintained on Tuesday, January 30 by Guggenheim. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Friday, April 20 by RBC Capital Markets. As per Wednesday, January 17, the company rating was maintained by Bank of America. The rating was maintained by RBC Capital Markets on Wednesday, March 21 with “Buy”. As per Tuesday, June 5, the company rating was maintained by Guggenheim. The stock of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has “Hold” rating given on Friday, February 2 by Bernstein. Argus Research maintained the shares of AAPL in report on Friday, June 8 with “Buy” rating. As per Friday, January 5, the company rating was maintained by UBS.
